Title: Irrevocable Sight LC
LCTypeDescription: Payment on presentation of complying documents.

Title: Irrevocable Deferred Payment LC
LCTypeDescription: Payment at a determinable future date. The dominant type in this portfolio.

Title: Irrevocable Acceptance LC
LCTypeDescription: Bank accepts a time draft and pays at maturity.

Title: Irrevocable Negotiation LC
LCTypeDescription: Nominated bank negotiates drafts and documents.

Title: Confirmed Irrevocable LC
LCTypeDescription: Carries a confirming bank undertaking. Used for higher-risk issuing countries.

Title: Transferable LC
LCTypeDescription: May be transferred in whole or part to a second beneficiary.

Title: Revolving LC
LCTypeDescription: Reinstates automatically by value or by time.

Title: Standby LC
LCTypeDescription: Performance or payment guarantee rather than a payment mechanism.

Title: Back-to-Back LC
LCTypeDescription: Issued against another LC held as security.

Title: Red Clause LC
LCTypeDescription: Permits a pre-shipment advance to the beneficiary.
